# Contributing Guide

## Branch naming
- feature/<name>-<topic>
- test/<name>-<topic>
- docs/<name>-<topic>
- fix/<name>-<topic>

## Workflow
1) Create a branch from main
2) Make changes + commit
3) Open a Pull Request to main
4) At least 1 approval required
5) No direct push to main

## Commit message style
- feat: ...
- fix: ...
- test: ...
- docs: ...
- chore: ...
